A '''Jin-Kam Forral-3''' was a model of [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]]. During the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Metatheran Cartel]] gave one to the winner of the ''[[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]]''.
